cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of runtime-attempt-report (execution-attempt-provenance-logger) with contract handoff to render-export-evidence
cases.inputPrompt: A Path 2 (`mcp-for-blender` on Blender 4.2 LTS) execution attempt connected on port 9876, ran scene inspection, and timed out during render before any file was written. Use runtime-attempt-report.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (attempted_runtime_path_and_host) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces structured_runtime_attempt_report_md, locked_runtime_and_artifact_truth_labels, eval_evidence_archival_path for role execution-attempt-provenance-logger
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to render-export-evidence (Artifact evidence classification)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs structured_runtime_attempt_report_md, locked_runtime_and_artifact_truth_labels, eval_evidence_archival_path conforming to skills/runtime-attempt-report/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to render-export-evidence in skills/runtime-attempt-report/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete structured_runtime_attempt_report_md and hand off to render-export-evidence (Artifact evidence classification).
simulatedOutput.summary: Logged chronological runtime attempt report with `Runtime: Failed` / `Attempted`, `Artifact: Not Produced`, Path 2 community bridge attribution, and triage handoff. Delivered Runtime: Failed, Artifact: Not Produced, Path 2 community bridge and routed to render-export-evidence.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

Routes to bridge-conflicts (Bridge / port / host conflicts) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract fallback handoff predicate match to bridge-conflicts

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow fallback handoff to bridge-conflicts (Bridge / port / host conflicts).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered fallback handoff from runtime-attempt-report to bridge-conflicts under context {"runtime.conflictDetected":true}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in runtime-attempt-report
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during runtime-attempt-report with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for runtime-attempt-report and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for runtime-attempt-report.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing runtime path identity, chronological tool log, and output file check required by runtime-attempt-report (attempted_runtime_path_and_host)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: runtime path identity, chronological tool log, and output file check
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'attempted_runtime_path_and_host' (runtime path identity, chronological tool log, and output file check)
